title: Oil temp sensor open
shortDescription: Oil temperature probe is open circuit.
fullDescription: The Wells fryer detected an open RTD on the oil sensor. Heaters are locked out for safety.

fixSteps.title: Check connector
fixSteps.instruction: Power off and reseat probe connector.

whenToCallPro: If sensor replacement does not clear, call a tech.

faq.a: Yes, drain to access probe safely.

title: Oil temp sensor shorted
fullDescription: Sensor is reading shorted. Replace probe and inspect harness for melted insulation near burners.

fixSteps.title: Replace probe
fixSteps.instruction: Drain oil, remove probe, install new one.

faq.a: Yes, same component reads differently when shorted vs open.

title: High temperature
fullDescription: Temperature climbed past hi-limit. Often a stuck contactor or calibration drift.

fixSteps.title: Power off
fixSteps.instruction: Turn off fryer immediately and let cool.

faq.a: Discard oil that exceeded smoke point.

title: Low oil level
fullDescription: Float or level sensor detected low oil. Heat is locked out to protect elements.

fixSteps.title: Top up oil
fixSteps.instruction: Add oil to fill line and clear error.

faq.a: Yes, but slowly into hot vat.

title: Heating slow / failed
shortDescription: Fryer not reaching set temp within timeout.
fullDescription: Heating element not delivering expected wattage. Possible burned-out element or contactor.

fixSteps.title: Check breakers
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm all phases of supply present.

title: Drain valve open during cook
shortDescription: Drain valve detected open while heating.
fullDescription: Safety interlock fired because drain valve was not fully closed. Heating disabled until closed.

title: Filter pump fault
fullDescription: Filter pump did not start or tripped its overload. Check filter pan placement and pump.

fixSteps.title: Reseat pan
fixSteps.instruction: Pull and reinsert filter pan; confirm interlock.

title: Lift basket motor fault
fullDescription: Basket lift motor stalled or limit switch failed. Manual operation possible.

faq.a: Yes, food-safe high-temp grease on track.

title: Communication error
shortDescription: Display lost contact with control board.
fullDescription: Internal bus error between user interface and main board. Power cycle and inspect harness.

title: Power supply fault
shortDescription: Low or unstable line voltage detected.
fullDescription: Control measured line voltage outside acceptable window. Check supply and breaker.

fixSteps.title: Check breaker
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm voltage at outlet matches nameplate.

whenToCallPro: Any panel work requires an electrician.
